title: Forge OS shared contracts
description: Canonical wire contracts for the Forge prompt-first OS (event stream, A2UI v1.0 profile, sessions, workspaces, windows, capabilities). Canonical copy: shared/os-schemas/. Byte-identical copies live in frontend/src/os/schemas/ and backend/core/os_schemas/ (drift-tested). Edit the canonical copy, then run backend/scripts/sync_os_schemas.py.
